decisions.reason: Product A has its own dedicated page, signaling strong public commitment and sunk marketing investment, so the firm is unlikely to drop it.
Product B has its own page, indicating visible commitment and invested resources, which creates escalation pressure to keep it.
Product C is only mentioned on the website, showing limited visible commitment, so the firm can drop it with less need to justify earlier investments.
Product D has a dedicated page, reflecting public commitment and sunk costs that make the firm likely to persist with it.
Product E is only mentioned on the website, indicating weak public commitment, so escalation pressure is low and dropping is more likely.
Product F is only mentioned on the website, suggesting little visible investment, so the firm may drop it without costly justification.
